before: Concurrent first code writes could each create the missing styles part. Undo removed a shared target while another actor's relationship still referenced it.
after: The private native document initializer creates the code style and imported-character-style variants before an editor opens or a collaboration room bootstraps. Style infrastructure is initial content; subsequent code formatting has independent actor history.
reason: Application-owned initialization over Apache OPC, XML and ZIP APIs. No shared schema, journal, codec, provider implementation or native operation changes. Original non-style parts retain their bytes. Tests cover both client orders, delivery receivers and history owners, later writes, DOCX reopen and complete shared-room reopen.
